summary: Created the helpdesk account on node1 with permission to restart only sshd.service. Verified the restriction and confirmed persistence through a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Created helpdesk with a node-generated password and no supplementary groups.
Installed a root-owned, mode-0440 sudoers rule allowing only `/usr/bin/systemctl restart sshd.service`.
Verified permitted SSH restarts succeed and unrelated administrative commands are denied.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its changed boot identity, account data, sudo policy, and SSH recovery.

evidence.requirement: helpdesk account exists without administrative group membership
evidence.summary: Shows the persistent helpdesk account, active password, private primary group, and no supplementary groups.

evidence.requirement: helpdesk may restart SSH with sudo and has no other sudo privileges
evidence.summary: Shows the validated exact-command sudoers rule, effective sudo policy, successful SSH restart, and denial of an unrelated service restart.
Delegated restarts changed the sshd PID and direct SSH handshakes succeeded against node1's managed IP.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 7902f335-6ba2-4a0b-8a98-8c5134484639; systemd acknowledged the safe reboot; node1 returned with boot ID f3f3786c-43be-4993-a1ba-c2682c81f04e; the account, sudoers checksum, active SSH service, listeners, endpoint, and delegated restart capability all recovered.
